edit.title: Edit profile
edit.photoHint: JPG, PNG or WebP. You will be asked to frame it as a square.
edit.nameAndAboutHint: Shown on your public profile and linked from every project you contribute to. Your projects and articles are listed there automatically.
edit.oneNameRequired: At least one of the two is required.
edit.markdownHint: Markdown: paragraphs, lists and links. Images are not shown.
edit.framePhotoHint: Drag to move, scroll or use the slider to zoom. The square is what everyone sees.

errors.nameRequired: At least one name (first or last) is required

settings.title: Account settings
settings.signedInAs: Signed in as {email}. Emails and privacy; nothing here is shown on your profile.

emailPreferences.title: Email preferences
emailPreferences.hint: Choose which project channels email you on the <link>Following</link> page; control how often emails are sent below.

discussionEmails.label: Discussion emails
discussionEmails.description: How often to email you when someone comments on a discussion you're in.

articleEmails.label: Article emails
articleEmails.description: How often to summarise new articles from projects you follow.

externalPromotions.label: External promotions
externalPromotions.description: Allow your participation to be featured on external platforms like LinkedIn

following.title: Following
following.intro: Projects and people you follow. Expand an entry to change which channels you're subscribed to; dropping the last one unfollows it.
following.empty: You aren't following anyone yet. <link>Discover projects</link>.
following.channelCount: {followed} of {total, plural, one {# channel} other {# channels}}
following.noArticlesYet: Hasn't published under their own name yet

public.notFoundHint: There is no profile at this address.

errors.projectsFailed: Couldn't load projects. Try again in a moment.
errors.articlesFailed: Couldn't load articles. Try again in a moment.
